title: After refusing the Ironbound and having Prior Halm have them walked off Stilt Row (Church rep +1, Brother Osk approved, narratively framed as the compassionate/right call), the journal marked 'Quest failed: The Mission's Order.' The 'failed' tag contradicts the positive in-fiction outcome and could make a player think they did something wrong when they didn't.
